description: Create or update the user's Daily Trading Plan for TODAY (UTC date — the same day the place-order `no_plan` guard checks). Step 2 of the /routine. Typical flow: read the 4-timeframe bias per pair from TradingView (`get-symbol-data-batch` with Recommend.All|15/60/240 + Recommend.All, ADX, Stoch), keep pairs aligned on all 4 timeframes that are not at an oscillator extreme, then save them here with a key level (pullback entry zone / invalidation). Pairs are MERGED into an existing plan by symbol (the user's own pairs are kept); other fields are only changed when passed. Never ticks the user's self-check boxes. Show the user the plan you saved. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.
